Design preset
Logo and caption
A white backing plate helps preserve readability. Very large logos may prevent scanning.
Design Studio controls the code's appearance. The background color is used for opaque exports; transparency is available only in Export & Sharing for PNG and SVG.
Decorative styles, gradients and logos can reduce scan reliability. This version prioritizes reliable solid-color output and checks the generated payload whenever possible.

Available for PNG and SVG only. JPG and PDF use the Background color set in Design Studio.
Uses larger pixel dimensions for selected digital presets. It does not add detail to vector SVG output.
PNG is lossless and supports transparency. Design Studio controls foreground and background colors.
SVG is vector-based. PNG supports transparency. JPG always uses a solid background. PDF is a genuine file with an embedded high-resolution QR rendering. Browser sharing and clipboard support can vary by device.

About QR Code Studio

A practical, privacy-conscious QR utility designed for everyday work.

VERSION 1.4.4

QR Code Studio

Generate. Customize. Scan. Share.

QR Code Studio combines QR code creation, visual customization, scanning, local bulk processing, export, and project management in a single HTML application. Core generation and export operations are designed to run locally without an account or server.

Privacy model
Core payloads and local images are processed in the browser. Projects remain in browser storage until exported or deleted.
Browser requirements
Camera scanning depends on secure-context browser APIs and camera permission, and generally requires HTTPS or localhost. Native QR detection is preferred. For broader compatibility, this version embeds the Nimiq JavaScript QR decoder directly in the HTML. It runs locally and does not require first-time downloads or decoder caching.

Current capabilities and limitations

  • Static QR generation uses an embedded QR encoder and supports QR versions 1–40, UTF-8 ECI for non-ASCII content, and error-correction levels L, M, Q, and H.
  • Dynamic QR editing and hosted scan analytics require an external redirect service or backend and are not simulated by this offline tool.
  • Bulk generation shares the main design and export settings, supports column-based payload templates and optional record-specific captions, and can independently decode-verify each generated artifact before packaging it into ZIP.
  • Print & Label Studio arranges the current QR, saved projects, or latest bulk-generated results into configurable physical label layouts. Bulk batches can span multiple print-ready PDF pages. The artwork is high-resolution raster output, not an editable vector PDF.
  • Brand kits save reusable Design Studio appearance settings. Full backup and restore packages projects, brand kits and interface preferences in a local JSON file.
  • Print & Label Studio arranges the current QR, saved projects, or the latest bulk-generated results on A4, A5, Letter, business-card, product-label, or custom pages, with physical margins, gutters, QR size, captions, numbering, multi-page PDF export, and browser printing. PDF artwork is raster-based; use appropriate resolution and test actual prints.
  • Brand kits store reusable appearance settings locally. Full backup/restore packages saved projects, brand kits, and interface preferences as JSON; keep backups secure if they contain sensitive QR payloads.
  • Live and image QR decoding use native QR detection when available and can fall back to the bundled Nimiq JavaScript decoder. The decoder is embedded in this HTML and is available offline, subject to browser support for workers and local file handling.
  • PDF export produces a genuine PDF containing a high-quality raster rendering, not editable vector QR paths. For the sharpest scalable artwork, use SVG; verify all outputs at final size before printing.
  • Excel import supports XLSX files when the browser provides compatible ZIP/Deflate decompression; CSV and TSV remain available as dependable alternatives. Imports are limited to 20 MB, 1,000 records, and 100 columns per batch.
  • The interface, validation, and built-in system messages are available in English and Arabic. File names, technical identifiers, browser-provided device names, and user-entered QR payloads are preserved in their original form.

Dependencies and attribution

QR encoding, rendering, ZIP creation, PDF creation, and the Nimiq qr-scanner 1.4.2 legacy decoder are embedded in this HTML file. The bundled decoder is initialized and tested against a locally generated sample QR at startup. No scanner bundle is downloaded at runtime, and QR images or payloads are not sent to a decoder provider. Scanner camera access still requires browser permission and usually HTTPS or localhost. No analytics or advertising integrations are included.
